summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the new State/City capture on the Entrepreneurship Workshop 'Book a Free Trial' lead form and the admin Trial Requests State/City columns, filters and CSV export. Backend: rewrote /app/backend/tests/test_trial_enquiries.py to include state/city (previous payloads were now 422) and added new cases (persistence of state/city, trimming, missing vs blank state/city) -> 24/24 passed. Frontend: full Playwright walkthrough of the public form (city disabled until state chosen, city list scoped to state, city reset on state change, both validation toasts, successful submit + dialog close) and admin tab (State/City columns, cascading State/City filter dropdowns, filtered/total badge, All States reset, CSV with state/city header) -> all passed. Regression on Trial Requests tab (status change + persistence, single delete, bulk delete) passed. All 3 TEST_ leads created were cleaned up via the admin UI (table now empty).

issues: Form fields are placeholder-only (no labels / no required-field markers) for State, City and Grade - once a value is picked the user loses the field's identity; minor a11y/UX nit, not a blocker
State/City filter Selects and CSV button are hidden entirely when there are zero leads (existing pattern, acceptable but means filters vanish after bulk delete)

critical_code_review_comments: AdminPage.jsx is 2192 lines - the Trial Requests tab (with its own filter state, table, CSV) should be extracted into its own component/file per the <700 line guideline.

State/City are validated as non-empty strings only on the backend; there is no server-side check that the city actually belongs to the submitted state (the frontend list is the only guard). If uniformity matters for reporting, consider validating against a shared server-side state->city map.

The India states/cities list is duplicated only on the frontend; if any other lead form (e.g. homepage 'Book a Call') later needs location, reuse /app/frontend/src/data/indiaStatesCities.js rather than re-declaring.
seed_data_creation: 3 TEST_ trial leads (Karnataka/Bengaluru via UI form, Maharashtra/Pune and Tamil Nadu/Chennai via seed script) - ALL deleted afterwards using the admin single-delete + bulk-delete flow; entrepreneurship_trial_leads is now empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_trial_enquiries.py now uses a base_payload() helper that always includes state/city - any new required field on TrialEnquiryRequest must be added there or all 24 tests will 422. Missing state/city -> 422 (pydantic), blank/whitespace -> 400 (handler). seed_trial_state_city.py can be re-run to repopulate leads for admin filter testing. Admin login: admin@learnersplanet.com / finlit@2026 via /login (auth-identifier-input / auth-password-input / auth-submit-btn), then /admin -> admin-tab-trial_requests.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no defects found. The only failures encountered were in the pre-existing backend test file whose payloads predated the new required state/city fields; those tests were updated (test-code-only change, in scope).
